entries.role: The exact Zhang2019 abstract,nomenclature and framework state two-stage carbon-tax uncertainty and three financial risk metrics with epsilon-constraint tradeoffs. Geological uncertainty is discussed as literature context. These passages do not establish that the authors own stochastic model calibrates geological storage failure. Onlypp1,2,4 inspected;remaining paper/citations/native model unverified. Financial scenario probabilities are not measured physical failure frequencies.
